label: copy phase, 3rd-4th recalled token is t/2/g/y/e, long sequences
predicate: (phase == 2) & isin(in_tok, [tok("t"), tok("2"), tok("g"), tok("y"), tok("e")]) & isin(recall_idx, [2,3]) & (L >= 7)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the copy phase (99.9% of mass), never at the delimiter or recall_idx 0, essentially never in the original phase. Input-token selective: the fed-back input is t (41% of mass), 2 (31%), g (11%), y (6%), e (5%). Position-selective: concentrated at recall_idx 2 (62% of mass) and 3 (29%), i.e. the step whose input is original token 1 or 2, with peak at t=11; stronger and more frequent in long sequences (L=9 holds 50% of mass). Top activations are t or 2 as the second original token in L=9 sequences, echoed at recall_idx 2. Does not fire on the same tokens at recall_idx 0-1 or in the original phase, and is weak/rare for these tokens in short sequences. Precision is limited (~44%): many t/2/g/y/e inputs at these positions stay below threshold, with no further clean condition found.
